“**Glenwood Pool**” could refer to several different places, but the most likely matches are:

- **Glenwood Pool in Columbus, Ohio** — a City of Columbus recreation pool at **1888 Fairmont Ave., Columbus, OH 43223**.[7]
- **Glenwood Pool / Glenwood Recreation Club in Silver Spring, Maryland** — a swim club in historic Forest Glen that says it is **currently at capacity** and has a long waitlist.[1][4]
- **Glenwood Hot Springs Resort in Glenwood Springs, Colorado** — a large hot springs complex with multiple pools, including the **world’s largest hot springs pool**.[3][5]
- **Glenwood Springs Parks & Recreation Aquatic Center** — a municipal aquatic center in Glenwood Springs, Colorado with an activity pool, lap pool, and hot tub.[2]
